x: We also have to announce the death of another old stalwart, George Tyrer, known to several generations of members as the man who made a point of turning out in the September road-run every year.
Lew Causer then celebrating his 20th season at cross country was leader and coach of the novice pack and a fine coach he was,ably assisted at times by George Tyrer.
